svg.title: Stack DNA: the stack, traced
svg.desc: The tools found in the manifests of 39 public repositories, drawn as a cross-section of a system in six layers. Each block is one tool, its width the number of repositories that use it, shown in brackets: Interface: React (19), Vite (10), Next.js (7), Tailwind CSS (7), Framer Motion (6), TanStack Query (4), Recharts (3), CodeMirror (2), Radix UI (2); Backend: FastAPI (12), Pydantic (8), SQLAlchemy (6), Zod (6), Express (4), Fastify (1), GraphQL (1), Prisma (1), Tokio (1); Agents: OpenAI (7), Anthropic (2), MCP (2), Ollama (2), Gemini (1), LangChain (1), LangGraph (1); Models: NumPy (7), OpenCV (4), pandas (4), scikit-learn (3), Tesseract (3), PyTorch (2), TensorFlow (2), Whisper (2), Matplotlib (1); Data: PostgreSQL (7), Firebase (4), SQLite (4), MongoDB (3), Redis (2), MinIO (1), Neo4j (1), Qdrant (1); Delivery: Docker (10), GitHub Actions (9), ESLint (8), pytest (7), Vitest (7), Playwright (6), Prometheus (4), Render (3), Vercel (3). Core means five or more repositories, working two to four, explored one. Below, the languages by bytes of code: TypeScript 36%, Python 29%, JavaScript 16%, Rust 8%, CSS 7%, HTML 3%. A trace runs up through the layers along the tools each flagship actually uses.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, SF Mono, Menlo, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace

g.text: Every block is a tool found in my repositories' own manifests. Width is how many repos use it; nothing here is self-declared.
